name: [REBORN]
source:
Nat Newman and Charles Chi, two teenagers who are facing a particularly similar fate: Kidnapped and forced to be the guinea-pigs of an experiment conducted by someone who calls themself "Sullu".

With nothing more than their knowledge and memories, your task is to make sure they both survive the experiment.

[from [url=https://kny-doggo.itch.io/reborn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
纳特·纽曼（Nat Newman）和查尔斯·奇（Charles Chi）这两个青少年面临着特别相似的命运：被绑架并被迫成为一个自称“苏鲁”的人进行的实验的实验对象。

除了他们的知识和记忆之外，你的任务就是确保他们都能在实验中幸存下来。

[来自[url=https://kny-doggo.itch.io/reborn]itch.io[/url]]
